findings.title: Registered metric-alert handler cannot be instantiated
findings.trigger: A Detector whose type is "metric_alert_fire" is processed and Detector.detector_handler attempts to instantiate MetricAlertDetectorHandler.
findings.verifier_reason: The patch changes MetricAlertDetectorHandler from inheriting DetectorHandler (with concrete evaluate method) to StatefulDetectorHandler which has abstract methods counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data. The class body is just 'pass', leaving these abstract methods unimplemented. Python will raise TypeError when instantiating this class. Line 11 shows the class declaration verbatim, and line 27 shows it's assigned to detector_handler on MetricAlertFire.

pr.body:
This adds a hook that can be implemented to produce an occurrence specific to the detector that is subclassing the StatefulDetector.

Also change the signature of evaluate to return a dict keyed by groupkey instead of a list. This helps avoid the chance of duplicate results for the same group key.
